scope: A meal must contain at least one recipe with an explicitly named, required meat/fish/seafood ingredient in the current legacy database. Absence is unknown, never vegetarian. Optional ingredients, eggs, sauces and compound products do not establish this evidence.
approval: No v2 source, assertion, revision or release is approved by this registry.

evidence_source.identity_check: Exact ID and NFC name together; rechecked against MySQL on every filtered request. No inference from recipe titles or absence of animal ingredients.
